title: What Would You Do? Discover Your BLACKPINK Personality
description: Answer 12 questions to discover your BLACKPINK personality!

questions.text: The group is discussing MV concepts for a new song. You would...

options.text: Focus on practical details like budget and shooting time
Propose filming at multiple locations to spark creativity
Imagine how the scene conveys the song's emotional core
Prefer a familiar studio to stay focused on details

questions.text: A last-minute equipment issue threatens the concert opening. You would...

options.text: Quickly analyze the problem and suggest technical fixes
Adjust the performance order to buy time
Calm the team with reassuring words
Follow the backup plan you prepared earlier

questions.text: An interviewer asks an unexpected question. You would...

options.text: Pause to gather your thoughts before answering clearly
Explore broader ideas beyond the question itself
Joke with the interviewer to lighten the mood first
Answer directly with specific examples

questions.text: Members disagree on the next song's style. You would...

options.text: Find a compromise that makes everyone happy
Stick to the original music plan for consistency
Evaluate which style fits the group's strengths best
Blend styles and see what develops during the creative process

questions.text: Designing a fan meeting game, you would...

options.text: Create a group activity to boost energy
Check if the rules are simple and props are easy to get
Suggest a quiet Q&A to connect with fans deeply
Invent a unique game that reflects the group's personality

questions.text: A member struggles with a dance move. You would...

options.text: Break down the steps and explain the technique
Practice with them privately and encourage patience
Skip it for now and revisit when the group is more relaxed
Adjust the schedule to give them extra practice time

questions.text: Backstage after winning an award, you would...

options.text: Thank specific staff like stylists and producers by name
Smile and nod, quietly appreciating the team's hard work
Think about how this win shapes the group's future path
Hug everyone and share the excitement openly
Mix elements and adjust the design as you go
Compare costs, usability, and sales potential
Prioritize designs that fans will find heartwarming
Stick to a theme and follow the design guidelines strictly

questions.text: Doing an outdoor challenge for a variety show, you would...

options.text: Work alone to finish quickly and efficiently
Team up with members and have fun while completing it
Guess the hidden purpose of the challenge and innovate
Read the instructions carefully to avoid mistakes

questions.text: A sudden free half-day due to canceled plans. You would...

options.text: Stick to your rest plan to prepare for tomorrow's schedule
Spontaneously explore a nearby attraction
Tackle unfinished tasks to stay productive
Watch a movie or chat with members to bond

questions.text: Negative comments about the group appear online. You would...

options.text: Reflect on underlying issues to improve future performances
Check the comments to see if a clarification is needed
Post a positive update to shift focus to good news
Ignore them and focus on your work to prove your strength

questions.text: Deciding the setlist for a world tour. You would...

options.text: Insist on including fans' all-time favorite songs
Leave some slots open to adjust based on rehearsal vibes
Finalize the list three months early for thorough practice
Adjust the genre ratio to match each city's culture

results.title: The Reliable Planner
results.description: You're the steady backbone of the group, thriving on structure and responsibility. Like BLACKPINK's precise performances, you excel at following plans and ensuring every detail is perfect. Dependable and practical, you keep the team grounded and on track. You're an ISTJ—methodical, loyal, and the group's rock.

results.title: The Caring Supporter
results.description: You quietly nurture those around you, always attuned to others' needs. Like BLACKPINK's unspoken bond, you create harmony by listening and offering warmth. Reliable and compassionate, you make the team feel safe to be themselves. You're an ISFJ—kind, dedicated, and the group's heart.

results.title: The Insightful Dreamer
results.description: You see beyond the surface, drawn to deeper meanings and possibilities. Like BLACKPINK's emotionally rich music, you infuse purpose into every project. Intuitive and idealistic, you inspire the team to aim for something meaningful. You're an INFJ—visionary, empathetic, and the group's soul.

share_hook: Ever wonder which BLACKPINK member you'd vibe with most? Most people guess wrong on the first try, and the result usually sparks a fun conversation.
